description:
DIAGNOSED AND MECHANISM-VERIFIED (2026-09-01 at 1d44ac7cd, row-set probe at
settlement under both schedules; design proposal in session scratchpad
kdt106-proposal.md, cold review in flight):

THE 14 FIFO-only over-wide specializations on enum_predicate_search root at
the settled row set of the erased shared spec
List.reduce_while_step/3[[a0_e], {:cont,:true}|{:halt,:false}, a2]:
FIFO settles rows=1/contributors=4 -- 10 accumulated rows crossed
ACTIVATION_INPUT_ROW_BUDGET=8 and collapsed to the single columnwise wide
row -> one wide reduce_while_cont target -> the 14-key cone. LIFO settles
rows=8/contributors=3 (at budget by luck) -> three narrow targets. Of
FIFO's 10 rows, SEVEN are one caller's ascent ladder (same element column,
monotonically growing closure-union column; conclude_preserving_frontier +
join-on-upsert keeps every superseded conclusion's row). The 4th
contributor is itself a WIDE key minted by an UPSTREAM collapse
(reduce_while/3 [int],:true collapsing at rows=10/12/13) -- collapse
cascades. So the collapser is the BUDGET and the fuel is ascent history.
Rows ascend per callsite within an epoch: the history forms CHAINS, and
chains are exactly the schedule-visible part; the per-callsite maximum is
schedule-independent.

TWO FIX SHAPES REFUTED BY PROTOTYPE (2026-09-01, do not rebuild):
(1) replace-on-conclude (this ticket's original direction, kdt.69.2
extended to rows): NON-SETTLEMENT -- 12,401 identical budget collapses,
fact-wait budget exhausted; the collapsed wide row round-trips through the
cont<->step recursion cycle and returns as contributed evidence; the row
count crosses the budget cliff (collapse at 9, un-collapse at 8) both
directions forever (49,714 aggregate movements, clean two-key alternation).
(2) ascent-replace (replace only when the new value subsumes standing,
else join): byte-identical non-settlement -- the alternation is between
the collapsed wide row and the ladder set, which are INCOMPARABLE.
Twice-measured moral: the row set's grow-only property during the drive is
load-bearing for termination; the fix must be inflationary in denotation.

FIX (proposed, prototype-validated): DOMINANCE ABSORPTION in
ActivationInputAlternatives::insert_row -- an incoming row dominated by a
standing row is not inserted; standing rows dominated by the incoming row
leave with its landing. dominates(d,s) := per-column s==d OR (var-parity
AND is_subtype(s,d)). The var guard is load-bearing: is_subtype treats
free vars as absorbing (contravariance turns [int] <= var-union into
dominance), and unguarded absorption dropped Enum.with_index's template
row -> misrouted element families -> JIT tag panic
(compiler2_jit_preserves_correlated_with_index_mapper_rows) -- the
documented template hazard manifest through is_subtype. Denotation stays
monotone (termination argument unchanged). Budget stays as the theorem's
backstop and stops firing on real programs (28->0 collapses on predicate).

PROTOTYPE RESULTS (1d44ac7cd + kdt106-dominance-guarded.patch, release):
FIFO==LIFO BYTE-IDENTICAL canon on ALL FIVE lenses (predicate, 00420,
00183, 00277 -- the family's second lens, its 1/6 gap gone -- range_map).
Executables monotone down: 207->203 / 53->53 / 180->170 / 59->51 /
217->203 (predicate = base-LIFO exactly, +16 boundary arg-lanes narrowed
into coherence with their targets). stdout byte-identical on every lens.
Lib suite 1525 passed / 2 failed -- both exact-equality pins measuring the
intended movement (inventory 217->203; fz-kdt.63 claims 174->172).

RECONCILIATION: fz-kdt.65's artifact-visible complaint (the predicate
207->221 wide cone born of kdt.63's churn removal) is repaired -- the
churn's rebased conclusions were accidental replace semantics; dominance
is the principled schedule-independent form. fz-kdt.64/82 NOT dissolved
(no narrowing path added; ladder narrowing made unnecessary instead) --
riders needed. fz-kdt.110 re-measure post-landing. fz-kdt.81 untouched.

DISPUTED SIDE-REPORT (kdt.104 round, kept): a harness-vs-production lens
divergence reported by one refuter, NOT reproduced by the builder across
all doors x5 md5-stable (trap candidates: --dump path-syntax selects
another dump kind; no-main fixture produces no dump). Re-verify with
explicit dump-kind syntax before treating as real.

comments.text: fz-kdt.105 measurement (post-landing, door = fz2 interp --dump backend=, release build): the FIFO-vs-LIFO key-set gap on enum_predicate_search falls from 35 keys to exactly 14. Base fba7d72e3: FIFO 217 keys, LIFO 182, 35 FIFO-only. With canonical clause order: FIFO 217, LIFO 203, 14 FIFO-only, zero LIFO-only. Every one of the surviving 14 carries the same over-wide join 'int | :false | :ok | :true' (Enum.all?/1#lambda@4125-4170/2, three Enum.all?/2#lambda@4286-4337/2, Enum.all_value_step/1, Enum.empty?/1#lambda@4753-4792/2, Kernel.</2, Kernel.==/2, Kernel.fz_op_eq/2, Kernel.fz_op_lt/2 and siblings) -- i.e. the 21 that vanished were the clause-ORDER class and the 14 that remain are exactly this ticket's transient-wide-join class, now isolated with nothing else mixed in. 00420 and 00183 are fully key-confluent FIFO vs LIFO at both base and head.
